selection.summary: Migrated posts.getRawPost and posts.getPostSummaryByPid socket methods to the Write API. Added postsAPI.getRawPost and postsAPI.getSummary in src/api/posts.js, preserving the original privilege checks ('topics:read', deleted-post guard) and the filter:post.getRawPost hook from SocketPosts.getRawPost (h3, h13) and SocketPosts.getPostSummaryByPid (h13). Added Posts.getRawPost/Posts.getSummary controllers (h5) and GET /:pid/raw and GET /:pid/summary routes alongside the existing GET /:pid route (h1). Removed both socket methods from src/socket.io/posts.js. Updated client call sites: postTools.js quote flow now calls the new raw endpoint (h4, h15, h19 confirms 'api' module availability) and topic.js post summary fetch now calls the new summary endpoint (h14, h20). Rewrote the three raw-post tests in test/posts.js (h2, h21) to use api.posts.getRawPost instead of socketPosts. Selected handles show the base implementations, route/controller/api surfaces, client call sites, and test scaffolding used; edits were applied against verified base content of these files.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles plus at most one presented, provenance-valid adjacent test read for a selected same-stem implementation source; native source projection and export unchanged.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
